supportEnvelope.basis: Conservative logical ground-support rectangle around visible stadium footing and compact entry steps. L/R are outer ground-support extremities, F is a virtual front corner enclosing the rounded facade, not a measured physical sharp corner. Rear corner [669,207] is hidden and inferred by parallelogram closure. Approximate +/-12 px.

W.basis: Manually selected visible long ground-support/entry-step edge along left facade toward lower right, approximately +/-8 px. Rounded corners excluded; local roof edges are not asserted to share an exact physical camera.

D.basis: Manually selected straight ground-support edge along right facade toward upper right, approximately +/-8 px. This is the short D direction with increasing source x.

heightReference.basis: Approximate main front facade/canopy vertical ruler, same source x. Base follows front entrance footing, top follows outer canopy lip above the central entrance. Rounded facade and lighting make exact correspondence uncertain; about +/-12 px. Excludes rear roof ribs and pitch bowl.

notes: Original RGBA generated image and runtime copy are byte-identical; no pixel edits, crop, alpha modification, recoloring or mirroring.
Crop is the half-open alpha>8 bounding box; PNG 1536x1024; all four corner alpha values are zero. Some RGB values outside visible architecture are nonzero with alpha=0 and are not visible floor haze.

Nominal targetHeight=1.1H is capped by ground clearance, yielding actual reference height approximately0.808921H, not strict1.1H. Actual W/D support spans approximately3.571734/2.8; per-side clearance approximately0.214133/0.1.

The inferred logical rectangle is centered by shared calibrate(); supports are not four measured physical corners of a rounded stadium. Unmeasured canopy/ellipse details and hidden geometry retain image-generation approximation.
Native4x3 landmark arena; not a scaled existing3x3 stadium. Orthographic ground-axis correction is applied at render time without changing source art.
